name: Slate
description: The workspace: notes, subscriptions and product metrics in one place.
notes: Money is now Spend, and a new Income page shows MRR against money out, with the verdict: loss, breaking even or profit
Paste a RevenueCat or Stripe read-only key in Settings, Integrations, and Income reads your MRR
Ctrl Alt N from any app opens your Inbox note in Slate Notes
A reminder a few days before each renewal, while Slate is open
